note: CLEAN-SHEET ROOM 3 BLOCKING GUIDE (Tyler, clean-sheet reset sec.16). Structural authority for the rebuild. No image operation was spent to produce it and no old Room 3 coordinate was read into it -- only the CAMERA is carried over, because the Thad depth relationship is the one part of the retired room that was measured, cross-checked and owner-accepted.

camera.law: drawnHeight(y) = k * (y - eyeLevelY), a 1.75 m man
camera.carriedFrom: the retired room's accepted curve: 227 px at y 506, 526 px at y 858, zero at y 239

bar.why: the room's spine. 780 px across and 341 px of depth, so the bar itself says how deep the room is; its far end dies into the back wall and the stair rather than into open floor, so there is no terminus to invent

back_wall.what: the back wall: its base runs y 497-505, so a man standing against it is drawn 219-226 px

front_doors.what: THE FRONT DOORS -- batwings on the left wall, cut by the frame, floor at y 800 (476 px man)

window.what: THE WINDOW -- street-side, night blue, left wall ABOVE the piano and clear of it

handbill.what: THE HANDBILL -- nailed to the left wall by the doors, at a reading height nobody uses

piano.what: THE PIANO -- upright against the left wall, mid-depth. 258 px tall because 1.3 m at a depth where a man is 349, NOBODY AT IT AND NOBODY NEAR IT

card_cluster.what: CARD CLUSTER bounds, 645x430 = 3:2: table, four players, four chairs, the empty fifth place nearest camera, and the abandoned hand

card_table.what: the round table itself; top plane y 578-640, near rim y 726, floor contact y 745

stove.what: THE STOVE -- iron box and pipe against the back wall, between the card floor and the stair foot

stove_man.what: THE STOVE MAN stands here, back of the room, coat on, hands to the heat (221 px at y 500)

stairs.what: THE STAIRS -- on the BACK wall, rising right to left. THE BAR'S FAR END DIES INTO THEIR FOOT, which is why this room has no terminus to invent

landing.what: THE LANDING -- and the man on it. There is always a man on the landing.

bar_cluster.what: BAR CLUSTER bounds, 780x520 = 3:2: counter, back bar, stools, brass rail, and the three patrons -- seated at the far end, leaning at the middle, standing at the near

chandelier.what: THE CHANDELIER -- hung over OPEN DIRT FLOOR, not over the table, which is the whole joke

portrait.what: THE FADED PORTRAIT -- back wall, left of the stove

mirror.what: THE MIRROR -- over the back bar, on the right wall behind the bar's near half

spittoon.what: THE SPITTOON -- foreground, short of the bar's near end, and it occludes

deke_reserve.what: FUTURE DEKE -- open near-left floor inside the doors, reserved and NOT implemented
